# Easy Parking Ltd - Gatwick Airport Parking Meet & Greet

Easy Parking Ltd is a family-run airport parking and premium valeting provider serving London Gatwick Airport (LGW). We offer secure, convenient, and stress-free Meet & Greet valet airport parking services operating 24 hours a day, 7 days a week.

## Core Services

### 1. Meet & Greet Airport Parking (Gatwick)
- **Description**: Drive directly to your Gatwick terminal (North or South). A professional, fully insured chauffeur meets you, inspects your car, collects the keys, and parks your vehicle in our secure facility. On return, your vehicle is delivered directly back to the terminal.
- **Highlights**: Zero transfers required, direct terminal drop-off and pickup, 24/7 service.

### 2. Valeting & Car Wash Services
- **Full Car Wash Service**: Premium inside and outside wash. Price: **£34.99**.
- **Outside Only Car Wash**: Exterior wash and hand dry. Price: **£14.99**.
- **Valeting**: Complete interior and exterior premium valeting options available as booking add-ons.

### 3. Electric Vehicle (EV) Charging
- **Description**: Multi-level fast charging service located directly within our secure compound.
- **Pricing**: Customers pay only for the exact electricity charged; no hidden processing surcharges.

### 4. Direct Transfer Services
- **Description**: Private, stress-free transport solutions from the parking facility directly to local hotels or other key destinations.

## Facility Security Standards
- **Surveillance**: 24/7 high-definition CCTV coverage monitoring all vehicle bays.
- **Perimeter Fencing**: Reinforced gated entry barriers with secure borders.
- **Staffing**: Continuously staffed with trained security attendants and regular patrols.
- **Location**: Minutes away from Gatwick North & South terminals.
